name: lorvex-chatgpt-mcp
description: Private Lorvex Cloud account access through OAuth, with the existing iPad bridge retained for migration.

interface.longDescription: Access your Lorvex account tasks, lists, calendar and habits from ChatGPT. Connect Lorvex Cloud with normal account sign-in; authorized routine updates work while the iPad is closed and sync when it reconnects. The existing iPad bridge remains available during migration.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me plan my week using the tasks already in Lorvex.
